mapper.sql: select callback_id, ledger_id, caller_number, caller_name, visit_time, visit_by, visit_by_id, satisfaction, visit_opinion, visit_result, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_callback
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when satisfaction = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as verySatisfiedCount, sum(case when satisfaction = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as satisfiedCount, sum(case when satisfaction = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as normalCount, sum(case when satisfaction = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as unsatisfiedCount, round(avg(case when satisfaction is not null then (5 - cast(satisfaction as unsigned)) end), 2) as avgScore from ai_callback

select date(visit_time) as date, sum(case when satisfaction = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as verySatisfied, sum(case when satisfaction = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as satisfied, sum(case when satisfaction = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as normal, sum(case when satisfaction = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as unsatisfied, count(*) as total from ai_callback where visit_time is not null and visit_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(visit_time) order by date
